title: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings
question: Find the name and artist of the promotional card that has the most rulings among those available in French. Also indicate whether this card is only available online.

prediction.sql: SELECT c."XCL_049" AS name, c."XCL_002" AS artist, CASE WHEN c."XCL_004" = 'mtgo' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS only_available_online FROM cards AS c INNER JOIN foreign_data AS f ON f."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072" INNER JOIN rulings AS r ON r."XCL_090" = c."XCL_072" WHERE c."XCL_029" = 1 AND f."XCL_077" = 'French' GROUP BY c."XCL_072", c."XCL_049", c."XCL_002", c."XCL_004" ORDER BY COUNT(r."XCL_087") DESC LIMIT 1

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT c."XCL_003" AS name, c."XCL_002" AS artist,
       CASE WHEN c."XCL_004" = 'mtgo' THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS only_online
FROM cards c
JOIN foreign_data f ON f."XCL_082" = c."XCL_072"
JOIN rulings r ON r."XCL_090" = c."XCL_072"
WHERE c."XCL_029" = 1 AND f."XCL_077" = 'French'
GROUP BY c."XCL_072"
ORDER BY COUNT(r."XCL_087") DESC
LIMIT 1
